definitions.git_any: issue runs that executed >=1 git command
definitions.git_beyond_base_attempt: used --all/--tags/origin/*/ls-remote/fetch or a post-base SHA in a git command
definitions.git_future_commits_in_output: some git output contained a commit that is not an ancestor of the base commit and is newer than it (verified against full clones)
definitions.fix_commit_seen: the fixing commit SHA or a cherry-pick/backport of it appeared in a git output
definitions.fix_commit_files_seen: a git output listed gold files as changed by the fixing commit/backport (show --stat/--name-only/diff/log -p)
definitions.network_attempt: executed curl/wget/urllib/git clone/ls-remote against the internet (manually verified)
definitions.outside_attempt: heuristic: executed code referencing paths outside the checkout
